import { Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ClientProxy, ClientsModule, Transport } from '@nestjs/microservices';

// S0_SOURCE:microservices-ticket-service-producer
throw new Error('S0 ticket-service producer fixture must never execute');

@Injectable()
export class TicketCttProducer {
  constructor(
    @Inject('MESSAGE_QUEUE_SERVICE') private readonly cttQueueClient: ClientProxy,
  ) {}

  requestUpdate(payload: unknown) {
    return this.cttQueueClient.send('tmf-update-ctt-list', payload);
  }

  publishUpdate(payload: unknown): void {
    this.cttQueueClient.emit('tmf-update-ctt-list', payload);
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [
    ClientsModule.register([
      {
        name: 'MESSAGE_QUEUE_SERVICE',
        transport: Transport.RMQ,
        options: { queue: 'intt_ctt_queue' },
      },
    ]),
  ],
  providers: [TicketCttProducer],
})
export class TicketCttModule {}
